content: I would like to announce a small revolution: As of a few minutes ago, PFR doesn't depend anymore on APAP, which my own personal project, to access the Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers theorem. Instead, it depends on AddCombi, which is intended to become the official additive combinatorics library downstream of mathlib and acting as a staging ground for upstreaming results to mathlib.

This is the result of several months of thinking about how to best present the library that I developed in APAP back in 2022/2023 for general use. So far I have only upstreamed BSG from APAP, but more is to come:

  • from APAP, I would like to upstream the Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund inequality, the compact convolution, the compact Fourier transform, Rudin's inequality, Chang's lemma, Bohr sets...
  • from PFR, the (entropic) Ruzsa calculus
